'''Operation: Ghostbreaker''' was a covert [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation carried out by the agent codenamed [[Cipher Nine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Hunt for the Eagle]]. In the wake of a terrorist attack that claimed the lives of over three thousand people on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] flagship [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']], Imperial Intelligence was contacted by [[Mia Hawkins]], who was hunted by the [[Ghost cell]] after attempting to leave it. After Cipher Nine contacted Hawkins in [[Mos Ila]], they together proceeded to locate the [[Ghost cell village]]. Though Hawkins attempted to leave along the way, she was captured and brought to the [[Old Man (Ghost cell)|Old Man]] just as Cipher Nine arrived to confront him. Cipher and [[Kaliyo Djannis]] proceeded to eliminate the Ghost cell operatives and the Old Man himself.
